snippet.title: If You Want to Change Your Life, Give Me These 10 Minutes | 6 Months Roadmap for Success
snippet.description:
If You Want to Change Your Life, Give Me These 10 Minutes | 6 Months Roadmap for Success. In this powerful special video by Readers Books Club, Dr Amiett Kumar shares a practical and life-changing roadmap to help you reset your mindset, goals, habits, and direction for the next 6 months.

Many people start the year with big dreams, resolutions, and goals, but somewhere in the middle, they lose clarity, motivation, and consistency. This video is your reminder that the year is not over yet. If you feel stuck, confused, tired, or close to quitting, these 10 minutes can help you restart with a fresh mindset and a clear plan of action.

This roadmap is designed to help you understand where you are, where you want to go, and what you need to change in your daily habits, thoughts, and actions to create real progress. Whether your goal is success, personal growth, manifestation, discipline, productivity, or self-improvement, this video will help you use the next 6 months with purpose and focus.

What You’ll Discover in This Episode:

- 6 Months Roadmap for Success: Learn how to plan the next 6 months with clarity, direction, and discipline.
- Mindset Reset: Understand how to shift your thoughts from confusion and self-doubt to focus and confidence.
- Goal Setting and Action Plan: Discover how to break your big goals into practical daily actions.
- Watch Before You Quit: Learn why your current struggle may be the turning point before your breakthrough.
If you want to change your life, reset your mindset, and achieve your goals in the next 6 months, give these 10 minutes your complete attention. This roadmap can help you restart your journey, rebuild your focus, and move toward success with clarity and confidence.
